content.content: the renderer and grammar artifact of rtlotqvy is necessary to uprztqnr and faithful to it in both directions: it enforces exactly what uprztqnr states — a webview panel with an interactive HTML page that presents the deccy graph — no stricter and no looser, and smuggles in nothing uprztqnr does not; fail on any rule that diverges in either direction, naming it
content.rationale: prose prerequisite with a tool-checkable artifact dependent: prose says what counts as conforming and the artifact enforces it, so the gate pins the two together in both directions; the review reads the renderer and grammar artifact alone, since the page shell and the composition are no longer its subject
